If E is conditional spectral erasure KL release, O is fair/reference physical-outcome KL, and C is categorical calibration savings, D(P_root||Q_root)=sum_internal w(E+O+average C)+E_leaf D(P_leaf||Q_leaf). This proves history compatibility, not influence payment of initial collision entropy, signed entropy decrements, or universal seed costs. The exact root debt at every state is pi_G a(1-a)Du+pi_H b(1-b)Dv; expected private-query releases are pi_G a^2Du or pi_H b^2Dv and selector release is zero. The nonnegative unused book L=wu cu+wv cv+Icore+7Icontrol-CE satisfies CE_root=7 Pi_control+E CE_leaf+E L_leaf-L_root exactly on every such stopped history; signed refunds are retained, no renewed source bank or fresh phase law is inserted.
